workload.staging_stream: supplementary, same cadence; never pooled into production reliability

window: Exactly 300 seconds from recorded schedule activation; first impairment separately recorded. Completed requests assigned by start; collection never extends endpoint.

detection.telemetry: declared observability fault plus native unavailable/missing/stale data_status; not a service outage

episodes: Predetermined non-overlapping phases; contiguous severity changes are episode ends, not healthy clearance. Stable restoration uses unchanged Phase 5 rule and cannot span the next impairment.

isolation.seed: same sealed Conventional controlled archive in all four environments
isolation.idle_bdi_crud: stopped after reset; resumes on ordinary candidate deployment
isolation.comparison: all logical SQLite tables and columns; exclude only PAT last-used timestamp written asynchronously by authenticated probes; retain raw hashes

publication: Existing immutable controls remain historical; new source must be reviewed/published/prepared/qualified before final cases
